figures.name: encoding_viz.png
figures.title: 0s representation overview
figures.caption: Saved training/held-out episode PCA, checkpoint-colored PCA, training losses, held-out window PCA, and historical probe/length-control/ARI results. No refitting.

figures.name: visuals/latent_prototypes.png
figures.title: Latent point clouds and three mean vectors
figures.caption: Held-out episode latents in training-fitted PCA; stars are train-only means. Heatmap cells are eight raw latent coordinates, not strategy probabilities.

figures.name: visuals/causal_prefix.png
figures.title: Causal-prefix inference
figures.caption: Previously computed train-only diagnostic probes on saved causal prefixes, using the same held-out cohort. The full-episode reference sees later behavior. No probe was fitted for this dashboard.

figures.name: visuals/specialist_match.png
figures.title: Prototype versus specialist matching
figures.caption: Saved action errors on identical states. Outlined cells are each target column's best match; the diagonal is the intended behavior match, not a guaranteed outcome.

figures.name: visuals/action_controls.png
figures.title: Action-prediction controls
figures.caption: Historical causal-history, correct-mean, wrong-mean and zero-context controls. Zero context uses the same 0s decoder with z=0; it is not separately trained vanilla BC.

figures.name: visuals/action_vectors.png
figures.title: Predicted and specialist action vectors
figures.caption: Saved same-state actions: solid arrows are the 0s decoder; dashed arrows are the specialist. One deterministic example per recorded objective; these are commands, not trajectories.

figures.name: visuals/physics_error.png
figures.title: Physics prediction across horizons
figures.caption: Previously measured position error with recorded joint actions. This isolates learned physics, not opponent prediction quality or closed-loop controller performance.

figures.name: latent_swap_rollouts.png
figures.title: Original Equation 3 prototype rollouts
figures.caption: Saved base-model predictions under identical initial states and blue commands. These are imagined paths, not simulator counterfactual ground truth.

figures.name: visuals/additional_scenes.png
figures.title: Additional held-out starting scenes
figures.caption: Three saved risk-source episodes (1000, 1100, 1199), each with three prototype swaps. Not one scene per objective. Fixed-horizon predictions lack the new inspector's stop markings.

figures.name: visuals/latent_swap_animation.gif
figures.title: Original latent-swap animation
figures.caption: Saved fixed-horizon Equation 3 forecasts. Playback starts only on request; states beyond capture are extrapolations, not confirmed episode continuations.

figures.name: visuals/latent_swap_animation_final.png
figures.title: Animation endpoint
figures.caption: The saved final frame of the same original animation, retained for static inspection.
